metadata.description: Unified Galaxy Rotation Curve Corpus v7.3: 438 entries (423 with rotation curves; 7,804 radial points). SPARC/175 (Lelli et al. 2016, AJ 152 157; HI and H-alpha tracers), THINGS/34 (Walter et al. 2008, AJ 136 2563; de Blok et al. 2008, AJ 136 2648), LITTLE THINGS/26 (Oh et al. 2015, AJ 149 180), WALLABY DR2/203 (WKAPP optimised kinematic models; Deg et al. 2022; Murugeshan et al. 2024). SPARC RA/Dec/Vsys/PA not available in a unified published table.

quality_tiers.1: Published, individually derived rotation curves with per-point uncertainties
quality_tiers.2: Automated pipeline (WALLABY WKAPP), peer-reviewed; per-ring uncertainties are pipeline estimates (lower limits)

metadata.citation: Flynn, D.C. (2026). Unified Galaxy Rotation Curve Corpus v7.3. Zenodo. Concept DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19425427 (cite the version DOI of the release used). Data descriptor: Flynn, D.C. (2027), Astronomy and Computing 58, 101179.

provenance.SPARC: inc/distance from Lelli et al. 2016 Table 1 (scanned MRT); RC data from SPARC website
provenance.THINGS: rotation curves: de Blok et al. 2008 rotation-curve files (values match github.com/igomezv/Reconstructing-RC-with-ANN; e_Vrot = column 7); kinematic parameters: de Blok et al. 2008 Table 2; coordinates: Walter et al. 2008
provenance.LITTLE_THINGS: rotation curves: VizieR J/AJ/149/180 rotdmbar, Type = Data rows; galaxy parameters: Oh et al. 2015 Table 1
provenance.WALLABY: WKAPP optimised models from CADC youcat cirada.Wallaby_dr2_kinematic_catalogue; distances dist_h from cirada.Wallaby_dr2_source_catalogue; release selection and checksums in wallaby_v73_provenance.json
provenance.note: SPARC ra_deg/dec_deg/vsys_kms/pa_deg absent — not published in a unified table; distributed across ~50 individual source papers

metadata.version_notes: v7.3 (2026-10-15): WALLABY re-sourced to the WKAPP optimised models of the DR2 kinematic catalogue with per-ring uncertainties; THINGS e_Vrot set to the combined error; JSONL regenerated (complete); uncertainty_type relabelled; descriptive text corrected. See CORRECTIONS.md.

corrections.summary: LITTLE THINGS: 839 Oh et al. (2015) model rows removed from rotation curves (moved to model_iso_oh2015); 877 observed rows retained; galaxy summaries recomputed.

WALLABY curves, geometry, distances and uncertainties re-sourced to the WALLABY DR2 kinematic catalogue (1,746 -> 1,426 points); Vdisp removed; THINGS e_Vrot = combined error (column 7); JSONL regenerated; uncertainty_type relabelled; descriptive text corrected.

known_issues: Vgas can be negative (net outward gravitational force of a centrally depressed gas distribution; Lelli et al. 2016) - use sign(Vgas)*Vgas^2 in quadrature
Vdisk/Vbul normalized to Upsilon=1 - apply mass-to-light ratio before use

Vbul.description: Bulge rotation at Upsilon=1. Zero for bulgeless galaxies.

galaxies.quality_notes: Tier 2 (automated pipeline): WKAPP optimised flat-disk kinematic model from the WALLABY DR2 kinematic catalogue (Deg et al. 2022; Murugeshan et al. 2024); kinematic release Vela Kin TR1. Velocity dispersion was fixed at 10 km/s in the fits and is not provided. e_Vrot is the quadrature sum of e_Vrot_avg (averaging) and e_Vrot_inc (inclination) as recommended by Deg et al.; treat it as a lower limit. Distance: WALLABY DR2 dist_h (Hubble flow, H0 = 70 km/s/Mpc). 30 arcsec beam: inner rings and Vrot below 50 km/s are affected by beam smearing.
